lines: Here I go!! Early bird gets the guardiaaaaan!!!
Our spearhead Kirara-senpai charged Draugr August with a fierce cry.
So the Oni maiden is first. Allow me to test your strength.
The demon grinned and readied her sinister scythe.
Don't screw with me!! You guys have really been pissing me off!!
So I've had my frost fully charged and waiting for you!!
Kirara-senpai lifted her leg overhead that she had been charging cold air around since about halfway through Valdo's speech and slammed it into the ground with all her might.
Alright! Kirara-senpai had opened up with her secret technique!
Huge ice pillars rose up and swallowed the Guardian like a tsunami of ice.
It was her finishing blow. And the moment she rushed forward and tried to smash her frozen enemy...
The Guardian, whom I thought had been completely frozen, shattered the ice and brandished her scythe.
Kirara-senpai came to a screeching halt and raised her arms in an attempt to block the Guardian's scythe bearing down on her.
But she hadn't anticipated this unexpected counter, and was instead blown away by the scythe's sweeping strike.
She crashed into one of the bookshelves, causing many of its books to fall to the ground.
Hmmm, perhaps I timed it a little too well. How careless of me to drop Master's books.
I-I'm okay! I was just a little surprised by it, that's all!!
She wasn't lying, but she also couldn't hide the fact that she was definitely a bit shaken from her ultimate ice technique being repelled so easily.
You'd be best served knowing that you're not the only one who can wield ice, Oni maiden.
Yeah well mine's not any old ice! It's the power of the Oni I inherited from my mom! The Kijin of Frost!
I am aware. And 'tis a magnificent power. Such a shame that you should be used as materiー
Long, echoing gunshots reverberated through the study.
The Guardian's limbs and head were all blown apart from her torso mid-monologue.
The dismembered Guardian thudded to the floor in bits.
You shouldn't yammer so much in the middle of a fight.
Special anti-sorcerer rounds. Six shots at once. Don't worry, it's my treat.
Annreed blew the smoke away from the muzzle like some old west gunman.
I thought I had only heard one gunshot, but apparently it was actually six shots simultaneously.
And special anti-sorcerer rounds at that. To think she'd caught her by surprise with them.
Just what I'd expect from Annreed the Reaper. You're a thorough one...
Yeah but I did all the work...
C'mon now, it worked because you kept her attention, Kirara-senpai.
Well, it still doesn't sit well with me.
Annreed spoke in a tense voice... but it wasn't in response to our conversation. She was looking at something else entirely...
What impatient savages. No wonder you refused my master's invitation.
The Guardian, who should have turned into chunks of meat, slowly rose to her feet.
Her blown-off head, huge holes in her torso, and even her mangled limbs were already back to normal.
There's a time and place Chevalier! Kirara-senpai!
Kirara-senpai charged up cold air again and charged toward the revived Draugr August.
Oni maiden. Your power of frost will no longer have any effect on me.
So what!? That's not the only trick up my sleeve!
Then I shall have to see those as well. I'm looking forward to it.
Still acting all high and mighty huh!? Well I'll knock you down a peg or two!!
Kirara-senpai's ice claws and the Guardian's scythe clashed as intense sparks flew everywhere.
They seemed evenly matched in close combat... or perhaps Kirara-senpai was the one at a disadvantage considering her ice didn't work?
But Kirara-senpai herself appeared to understand that.
At first glance, she looked like she was recklessly attacking the Guardian in anger, but...
Yes, well done! She pushed the Guardian back to a good position.
It was as if she had read Kirara-senpai's mind.
Without any kind of prior planning, Annreed fired rounds from the enemy's blind spot.
Draugr August's body was once again riddled with large holes.
You wish to face me together I see. Very well. 'Tis a futile endeavor regardless.
The result was the same as before, or rather, she looked even less damaged than before and her wounds were already regenerating.
Hey!! Can't you just fire a hundred shots at once!?
Don't be ridiculous!! My Jet Revolver is a six-shooter. Plus it's not like I can carry infinite ammo!
Then what do we do!? Fuma! Chevalier! Don't just sit there, do something!!
Yes, do try whatever you may. I have high hopes for you both as well.
Draugr August was fully composed while she dealt with the coordinated attacks by Kirara-senpai and Annreed.
Our opponent was a cold user on par with Kirara-senpai.
As long as ice skills were ineffective, there would be no point in using Kirara's other ability, her substitution Jutsu, to launch a sneak attack.
And Annreed's attacks were working, but she regenerated immediately...
To make matters worse, she was running out of special rounds.
Grngh... Chevalier, have you picked up on anything?
Such ambiguous questions are the kind Chevalier hates the most.
Does that matter now!? That regenerative ability's unfair!
Indeed. She doesn't need to flaunt it like that.
It's no use. These scratches are nothing to me.
Indeed, she was still making a display of her body regenerating after being torn to shreds by Kirara-senpai and Annreed.
She did so without the use of recovery magic, healing, tools, "spares," or anything of the sort.
As I recalled, she'd kidnapped Shikanosuke and Hebiko, and upon seeing Kirara-senpai, who possibly had the blood of a divine Oni tribe, had been happy to obtain her as a "spare."
However, with such a powerful regenerative ability, there shouldn't be any need for "spares" in the first place.
In which case, perhaps she was faking the need for a spare.
Or perhaps the powerful regenerative ability before our eyes was a fake.
I didn't see the logical consistency in making us think she needs spares if it were the former.
Considering that, there was a single line of thought that connected all of it.
Tell me, how do you break illusion magic?!
Now why do you ask that?
Chevalier's eyes shined with deep curiosity.
Her true ability isn't the power to manipulate cold or some powerful regeneration. It's the ability to create illusions!
That would explain why we saw Valdo's illusion, and why she would need a spare despite having what seems to be such strong regeneration.
It's a pity you're a human. You have such a wonderful intellect.
Mm-hm-hm. Once she knows it's an illusion, it's easy for Chevalier to break it.
Chevalier opened her book, flipped through its pages, and began to read as if she were reciting a poem.
The dream-maker. That which deceives men, the embrace of Nyx, the smile of Erebus.
The end of the night, the end of the dream. The beginning of the morning, the beginning of the present.
Awaken now, ye spirits of heaven. Awaken now, ye spirits of the earth.
Strange rhythmic words of various pitches were rippling through the air.
Those words shook not only my eardrums, but all five of my senses.
And the moment that happened I found that the landscape had completely changed. My surroundings transformed into the same altar we had been in up until a moment ago.
But we hadn't been transported back here.
The entire room itself had been an illusion made to look like a study.
I could also see Hebiko and Shikanosuke sleeping soundly beside the altar.
Huuuh!? Where are we!? Where'd she go!?
So that's what it was. She really pulled a fast one on me...
Kirara-senpai and Annreed had both been surprised.
In addition to the sudden change in scenery, the Guardian they had just been fighting had disappeared as well.
Everything up until just now was an illusion!
So that means we were forced to put on a dumb show with a phantom opponent.
So where's the real one!? Where are they!?
The real one is back there.
Chevalier closed her book and pointed.
To think... that you would be able to dispel my illusion...!?
Draugr August had appeared from behind the altar.
The black veil made it hard to tell, but the slight glimpse of her eyes made it impossible for her to hide her agitation.
Kirara-senpai!! She's not able to regenerate her wounds anymore, you can beat her now!
With the real one before her now, Kirara-senpai didn't hesitate to charge at the Guardian.
There was a high-pitched clear sound as cold air was rapidly charged.
Kirara-senpai poured all of her rage into this ice claw...
And unlike before, the Guardian did not try to take it head-on, but instead chose to dodge it.
Ahaha! What's wrong? You don't want to have it out with me like before?
Should couldn't even if she wanted to. She could no longer defend against Kirara-senpai's cold.
And they were roughly equal when it came to martial prowess. In which caseー
Not so tough without your illusions now, are you!!
The Guardian's left arm fell limp like a stick.
Though it was only in the most fleeting of moments that her claw managed to scrape it, Kirara-senpai's ice still managed to freeze it over.
It really won't regenerate, will it? I guess it doesn't work without a spare. Well, that's just how the cookie crumbles.
Kirara-senpai was keeping her distance and calmly observing her opponent.
The Guardian furiously swung her scythe with her remaining right arm, but...
This time her right arm had been blown off at its base.
With scythe still in hand, her arm tumbled to the ground with a clang.
Better not forget about me. I've had enough of being made a fool of too.
Quite the cool declaration from Annreed.
I'm sure the reason she fired one shot instead of six was because her target wouldn't be able to hear the line if she was shot to bits...
Very spiteful. As expected of the Reaper.
Damn you! Damn you! You vile intruders!
The Guardian, who had boasted of her invincibility, had lost her illusory powers, her weapon, both arms, and now could only grit her teeth in frustration.
I do feel bad doing this to a defenseless opponent... but it didn't feel good having my secret technique broken by an illusion either, so I'm making sure you don't get back up this time.
She repeatedly stomped the ground with legs which were charged with even more cold than usual.
Here goes!!! Cold charge 120%! Ultra Super Freeze!
Her long, slender leg extended skyward, then slammed into the ground with tremendous force.
A huge frozen tsunami twice the usual size swallowed up the Guardian in an instant.
In the middle of shouting words of apology to her master, Draugr August had been imprisoned in an icicle.
Just as Kirara-senpai joined her hands and started to cry out her finishing blow...
Now just hold on there. You froze her, so you should be satisfied. It's my turn now.
Kirara-senpai slightly knit her brow in disapproval at being interrupted at the last moment, but...
I'd normally never let this kind of thing happen, but we made a kinda good combo today, so I'll let you do the honors.
Thanks. Alright, I'm not holding back either then!
Annreed gave Kirara-senpai a sly wink, then aimed her gun at the Guardian.
A strange tattoo rose to the surface of Annreed's body.
It was clearly magical in nature.
A massive amount of energy then gathered in her Jet Revolver.
The muzzle of her gun shined glaringly...
...and a dazzling flash of light burst forth.
A massive shot of energy engulfed the frozen Draugr August and instantly scattered her body in all directions.
And thus we had defeated Valdo Bardo's powerful Guardian and gained complete control of his dwelling.
From there, we safely freed Hebiko and Shikanosuke, and we also found Valdo's real study. A bit less illusory this time. And inside it had been a vast collection of books and magical items.
I'd tentatively taken up one or two, but I couldn't even tell what language they were written in.
It may have been a language created by and for the sorcerer alone. Even a bookworm like me had to throw up his hands in defeat.
The books are arranged in a different order than the illusory room before. Quite elaborate.
Chevalier too was wearing a full-faced smile of satisfaction.
Do you think the book I'm looking for is here?
This place is brimming with objects that even Chevalier cannot comprehend. It will take some time to parse through everything.
I'd like to ask you to continue your analysis.
There's no need to ask. To Chevalier, the search for the unknown is the greatest joy.
The reply had been expected. However...
Even so, a librarian is required.
Chevalier didn't answer, but instead, seeming thrilled to be surrounded by countless unread books,
she pulled "that" from the breast of her clothing.
It was Draugr August's heart, still in one piece and beating after she'd been shredded to bits.
Hey, what're you planning to do with thaー
Chevalier had taken out yet another small bottle, then poured its unidentifiable liquid contents over the heart and placed it gently on the floor.
The next instant, the door at the back of the study slammed open, and icy human hands, feet, a torso, and internal organsーessentially a dismembered corpseーcame crawling in.
So this is what a "spare" is. Pretty nasty.
The spare parts slipped and crept their way toward the heart, assembling themselves into a human form.
It was, in a word, horrific.
I thank you for resurrecting me.
Draugr August, completely restored to her original form, had slowly risen to her feet.
Chevalier had a calm expression on her face, but we were naturally on guard.
Draugr August was surveying her surroundings restlessly.
Though she looked at us, she didn't particularly react, and I couldn't sense any hostile intentions.
She appeared to be either in a half-asleep daze after waking up or just completely at a loss for what to do.
Chevalier, who seemed to be the only one comprehending the situation, began to speak.
It would certainly appear so. Hmmm, how vexing...
Ever since I was created, I've never been free to act of my own will.
I do not doubt it. As such, here is a proposal. Chevalier would have you help in her search as a librarian here.
And you shall also act as a guard against any insolent intruders. You will be compensated, of course.
Ah, so that's what she was playing at.
So Chevalier had resurrected Draugr August as a partner to analyze Valdo's study.
But still, "insolent intruders?" That was us up until a few moments agoーheck, we technically still were.
This selfish nature of hers wasn't so different than the previous master here...
All except Chevalier had been watching in suspense to see how Draugr August would answer. Eventually...
I accept. However, I desire occasional reprieve.
Now that I am at last a free woman, I wish to broaden my horizons.
This one was a bit selfish, as well.
Did she think it would be alright for her walk around outside despite being undead?
However, Chevalier didn't seem bothered, and instead nodded as if pleased with the request she had made.
Chevalier approves. We have a contract, then.
Well then, my new master. I look forward to serving you from this day forth.
Draugr August knelt down and bowed respectfully.
Well, this didn't turn out quite how I expected... But anyways, I'm counting on you to report back to me with your findings, Chevalier.
Expectation is the source of all forms of anguish. You do know that, yes?
There's been no shortage of that for me lately. But hey, I'm nothing if not stubborn.
Mm-hm-hm, such an interesting human. Then do wait in anticipation.
Hey Mistress, just let me know if you ever find out where that creepy-ass sorcerer Valdo is hiding.
Shikanosuke and Hebiko had been kidnapped, we were deceived by illusions, and just overall had a terrible time of it on this trip, but this was case closed for now apparently.
Now then, the job's done, so let's blow off some steam with a party, Captain!
You mean it? Then how about getting it on with me while we celebrate, too?
Hey, you!! Wh-What do you mean, g-g-getting it on!!!?
Fuma-chan! What's going on here!!? What happened while Hebiko was passed out!?
Yeah, haven't done anything so far so why not? It'd make a good memory for the two of us. Come on, let's do it.
Well, that certainly sounds a littleー
A little what!? Just refuse her, Fuma-chan!!
Just what kind of memories does that mean Fuma!? Yoooooooou!!!
I had to endure Hebiko's grilling while Kirara-senpai raised her voice to murderous pitch.
H-Hey, come and visit Gosha. I'll show you around.
For some reason, he was so keenly interested in Draugr August that he'd willfully started talking to her.
Master, shall I dispose of them as part of my duty as a librarian?
No need for that. Wisdom is sometimes born of chaos. And this type of excitement is quite nice at times as well.
Annreed!! Get your hands off Fuma! You've been way too friendly with him from the start!!
Then how about the three of us? We had good chemistry in battle. I'd love to see if we're compatible in other areas too.
D-D-D-Don't be stupid! The three of us... THREE of us... you perv, you huge perv!!
Th-, three of us, huh... urghh!
Fuma!? What's with that bloody nose!?
Hebiko can't believe this!! Stupid Fuma-chaaaan!!
And then there's Inageya's ice cream. It's super delicious! Hey, you feel like eating now?
We had finally discovered the sorcerer's study... but our little uproar would continue for quite some time still...
